name: Severance pay with the one-fifth rule
workings: One fifth of the severance pay: T(56,674) = 12,969.208297; the extra × 5 = 17,848.7625
Income tax 27,248.218297; without the rule 20,067.99 more instead of 17,848.76
Soli on the total: 11.9% × (27,248.22 − 20,350) = 820.887977; no contributions on severance pay
